description: Delegate a bounded sub-task. Without mode_id: cheap minimal-brain worker (no persona). With mode_id (+ case_id): specialist modes/<id> worker on a Case (same as former delegate_mode). Parent plans; worker executes. Do NOT paste large data—save to file and pass path in context. Returns sub-id; use delegate_wait for results.

task.description: Executable brief: (1) goal (2) input paths/commands—no huge pasted data (3) output path+format+acceptance (4) scope/forbidden edits

context.description: Facts parent already knows: data file paths, schema/columns, decisions, format—so worker does not re-explore. Strongly recommended.

mode_id.description: Optional specialist mode under focus_path/.cata/modes/<id>/. When set, case_id is required.

case_id.description: Required with mode_id: Case folder cases/<case_id>/ for artifacts

read_artifacts.description: With mode_id: artifact names to read

write_artifacts.description: With mode_id: artifact names to write

tools.description: Tool whitelist e.g. read_file, search_replace, create_file, run_command

max_rounds.description: Max tool rounds (default config subagent.default_max_rounds, max 16)

wait.description: If true, block until this worker finishes
